acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 30,000, with a fill time of 94 ms and a limitation of 1 × 105 ions.
cleavage_agent: Further parameters were trypsin as a protease with an allowance of a maximum of two missed cleavages
collision_energy: A normalized collision energy of 34 was applied.
enrichment_method: we added low-solubility protein-enriched fractions (LSF) that could be potentially underrepresented in WTL to the analysis
fractionation_method: Off-line high pH reverse phase fractionation
Off-line high pH reverse phase fractionation was carried out on an Agilent 1200 Infinity high-performance liquid chromatography system
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer
an UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano LC system (Dionex) ... was coupled directly to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization_type: coupled directly to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) using the Nanospray Flex ion source in positive ion mode.
labeling: In-depth quantitative proteomic LC‒MS/MS analysis was performed for these samples ... using 16-plex TMT labeling
mass_analyzer: inferred: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer
ptm: Carbamidomethyl (C), TMT16 (K), Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M), TMT10 or TMT16 (N-term)

The following modifications were included into the search parameters: Carbamidomethyl (C) and TMT16 (K) as fixed modifications, Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M) and TMT10 or TMT16 (N-term) as variable modifications.
